title: Avatar
description: Represents a person with a picture or, when no image is available, the initial of their name.

support.notes: All six named sizes and numeric dimensions; image failure fallback, CJK/word initials, shape, stacked and descriptive/decorative labels. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: Avatar
translationResources.description: Represents a person with a picture or, when no image is available, the initial of their name.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Emma uses an image; Liam uses initials; Noah demonstrates a failed image and the final avatar has no name.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large.

group.title: Avatar group
group.description: The same four people appear in an overlapping group, with a +5 overflow indicator.

fallback.title: Fallbacks, sizes and max
fallback.description: Initials use the first letters of two words (or the first CJK character); fallback or children replace them. size also accepts pixels, and AvatarGroup max collapses the rest into +N.

AvatarProps.src: Image URL. When omitted, the first letter of name is shown
AvatarProps.name: Name of the person; used for the initial, alt text and accessible label
AvatarProps.size: Avatar size: a preset (xsmall 24px, small 32px, medium 48px, large 64px, xlarge 80px, xxlarge 96px) or a number of pixels
AvatarProps.stacked: Uses tighter margins for overlapping avatars
AvatarProps.alt: Alternative text of the image; pass "" for a decorative avatar
AvatarProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the avatar (and default alt text of its image)
AvatarProps.fallback: Custom fallback content shown instead of the initials when there is no image
AvatarProps.children: Fallback content used when there is no name (e.g. an icon)

AvatarGroupProps.count: Number of additional avatars, shown as a "+N" indicator
AvatarGroupProps.max: Maximum number of avatars to display; the others are counted in the "+N" indicator (added to count)

cssVars.--avatar-group-overlap: How far each avatar overlaps the previous one
cssVars.--avatar-size: Width and height of every avatar (overrides the size presets; a numeric size prop wins)
cssVars.--avatar-radius: Corner radius of the rounded shape (defaults to --radius-sm)
cssVars.--avatar-bg-color: Background color when no color is set (defaults to --info-color)
cssVars.--avatar-stacked-overlap: How far a stacked avatar overlaps the previous one

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: An image (src), or the initials of name when there is none. Without a name, the default slot holds the fallback content; name it with aria-label.

shapes-sizes.title: Shapes and sizes
shapes-sizes.description: Three shapes, six size presets, or a number of pixels.

group.title: Avatar group
group.description: minerva-avatar-group overlaps stacked avatars; max limits the visible ones and count adds hidden ones to the +N indicator.

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: When the image fails to load, the initials are shown, or the fallback slot when filled.

slots.default: Fallback content used when there is no name (e.g. an icon).
slots.fallback: Custom fallback content shown instead of the initials.
